mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with INDPRO growth > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with both HOUST and RSAFS growth > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 1.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS > 140,000) signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS > 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI increase above 2.5% YoY (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected monetary tightening.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% YoY.
